'''2011 Luxembourg Regionals Floris de Vries LS Yavin 4''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Floris de Vries]] at [[2011 Luxembourg Regionals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Deck name:''' Liberation mains
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Virtual Block 7.2]]
